PUNJAB CINEMATOGRAPH RULES, 1984
PUNJAB
CINEMATOGRAPH RULES, 1984
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 15th October, 1984]
No. SO (P & C)‑VI‑14/81.
In exercise of the powers conferred on him by section 19 read with subsection
(4) of section 13 of the Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979, and Government of
Pakistan, Culture, Sports and Youth Affairs Division, Notification No. F. 4‑8/79.‑-Films
dated the 13th December, 1979), the Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make the following ; namely:--
CHAPTER 1 INTRODUCTORY
1. Short title and commencement.‑--(1)
These rules may be called the Punjab Cinematograph Rules, 1984.
(ii) They shall
come into force at once.
2. Definitions.‑--In
these rules, unless the context otherwise requires:--
(i) 'Ordinance'
means the Motion Pictures Ordinance, 1979 ;
(ii) `Auditorium'
means that portion of the building or place which is occupied by the audience
or spectators during a cinematograph exhibi tion ;
(iii) 'Cinema'
means any place where exhibition by cinematograph is given ;
(iv) 'Cinema
building' means a building in respect of which an annual license has been
or may be granted under Rule 5 ;
(v) 'Electric
Inspector' means an Inspector appointed under section 36 of the Electricity
Act, 1910;
(vi) 'Enclosure'
means that portion of a place licensed under section 13 of the Ordinance in
which the cinematograph apparatus is installed ;
(vii) 'Executive
Engineer' in relation to the licensing of any place or premises for
cinematograph exhibition means the officer holding charge of that Division of
the Buildings Department of Communications and Works Department of the
Government of the Punjab in which such place or pre mises is situated ;
(viii) 'Civil
Defence Officer' means the officer appointed by the Govern ment as such in
a District/Tehsil ;
(ix) 'Association'
means the Pakistan Film Exhibitors Association registered as a trade
organization under the Companies Act, 1913 and Trade Organization Ordinance,
1961;
(x) 'Exit' includes
an emergency exit and any entrance useable by the public as an exit ;
(xi) Fire
resisting material means‑
(a) burnt brick‑work,
cement, concrete and reinforced brick‑work or cement concrete having a
minimum cover of one inch ;
(b) terra cotta
blocks securely bonded provided that no side or web thereof is less than one
and a half inches in thickness ;
(c) Stone,
tiles, solid gypsum blocks, marble, iron, steel, copper asbestos or zinc ; and
(d) such other
material as Government may by notification in the official Gazette declare to
be the fire resisting material ;
(xii) 'Form' means
a form appended to these Rules ;
(xiii) 'Government'
means Government of the Punjab;
(xiv) 'Licensee'
means the person or persons whose name or names have been entered as such
in the licence ;
(xv) 'Licensing
Authority' means the licensing authority under sub-section (2) of section
13 of the Ordinance ;
(xvi) 'Licensed
premises' means a place licensed under section 13 of the Ordinance ;
(xvii) 'No
Objection Certificate' means a certificate issued by the appropriate
authority under Rule 3 ;
(xviii) 'Open Air Cinema' means it
building which is permanently equipped for cinematograph exhibition but whose
auditorium is partly or wholly pen to the sky;
(xix) 'Superintending
Engineer' in relation to the licensing of any place or premises for cinematograph
exhibition means the officer holding the charge of that circle of the Building
Department of Communications and Works Department in whose jurisdiction the
Division falls and in which such place or premises is situated;
(xx) 'Touring
Cinematograph' means a cinematograph apparatus which is so constructed that
it can be taken from place to place for the purpose of giving cinematograph
exhibitions
(xxi) `Touring
cinematograph of the safety class' means a touring cinematograph in which
an incandescent lamp is used for the projector ; and
(xxii) 'Urban
area' means a local area, a town municipality or city under the Punjab
Local Government Ordinance, 1979.
